title: Practice: Greeting Formatter
brief:
As a user, I want the app to greet me by name, so that it feels friendly. This is a practice story: take your time to explore the interface.

Acceptance criteria:
- I am greeted by my preferred name if I have one, otherwise by my first name.
- A user without a name cannot be greeted: the app reports an invalid request.

steps.summary: Add a helper that greets several users
Add unit tests and a README section

probes.question: Which tones can a greeting have?
formatGreeting is called with { name: "Grace Hopper", preferredName: "Amazing Grace" }. What does it return?
What does greetAll return for an empty list of users?
options: A list with one empty greeting

items.question: A user named "Ada Lovelace" has a preferred name that is only spaces. Which greeting do they get?
options: It is rejected as an invalid request

items.question: A user with the formal tone has the full name "Ada Lovelace" and the preferred name "Ada". Which greeting do they get?
A user with the formal tone is named "Ada  Lovelace", with two spaces between the names. Which greeting do they get?
options: Good day, Ada  Lovelace. (both spaces kept)
It is rejected as an invalid request

items.question: greetAll gets three users; the second has a preferred name that is only spaces. What does it return?
options: Three greetings, the second by first name
Two greetings: the second user is skipped
Three greetings, the second without a name

items.question: greetAll gets three users; the second has a blank name. What does it return?
options: Nothing: it fails with an invalid-request error
Two greetings: the second user is skipped
Three greetings, the second without a name
